alerts.slo: Public landing and signup p95 <= 2500 ms, success rate >= 99 percent over 5 minutes
alerts.condition: synthetic public_landing or signup_submit_provider_off fails twice or 5xx rate > 1 percent for 5 minutes

alerts.slo: CRM list first usable rows p75 <= 2500 ms and detail header p75 <= 1200 ms
alerts.condition: crm synthetic fails twice or p95 exceeds SLO for 10 minutes

alerts.slo: Repository migration checksums match runtime ledger before promotion
alerts.condition: migration checksum mismatch or expected migration missing

alerts.slo: Pending outbox age p95 <= 10 minutes in sink/test mode and dead letters are zero unless explicitly acknowledged
alerts.condition: queue age > 10 minutes, duplicate attempts increase, or dead letters > 0 for 10 minutes

alerts.slo: Provider status checks are configured, disabled, or degraded with no hidden unknown state
alerts.condition: telegram, whatsapp, email, vimeo, buffer, stripe_test, or zoom provider status is degraded for 15 minutes

alerts.slo: Auth failure spikes, MFA failures, session revocations, and cross-scope denials stay under baseline
alerts.condition: auth failure rate doubles from 24 hour baseline or cross-scope denial count > expected synthetic baseline

alerts.slo: Class launch readiness and reminder sink delivery are green before class window
alerts.condition: class launch readiness is unavailable or reminder outbox misses delivery window

alerts.slo: One Time local support receipts continue while async BNA support consumer is unavailable
alerts.condition: support bridge cached state unavailable while local receipt count continues

alerts.slo: Backup, PITR, and restore drill evidence is current and passing
alerts.condition: backup evidence stale, PITR disabled, or restore drill failed

alerts.slo: Runtime source SHA and config/provider mode match release manifest
alerts.condition: source SHA mismatch, config_mode mismatch, or provider mode not expected
